newsitem.title: KENYA: Seven Kenyan policemen killed in Mombasa attack.
newsitem.headline: Seven Kenyan policemen killed in Mombasa attack.

text.p: Heavily armed attackers killed seven policemen on Wednesday night in the Kenyan port of Mombasa, police sources said on Thursday.

They said the seven and an unspecified number of civilians were killed in attacks on two police stations at Likoni. A Reuters correspondent in Mombasa went to the local morgue and counted the bodies of 10 victims of the violence.
The police sources said the assailants appeared well organised and withdrew immediately after the attacks. They also set fire to a number of buildings and vehicles.
It was unclear who the attackers were and what their motive was but Mombasa police were due to make a full statement later on Thursday.
The city on the Indian Ocean is about 500 km (310 miles) southeast of the capital Nairobi and is a centre of Kenya's tourist industry as well as its main port.
